_comment: Acceptance-criteria manifest, mirrored out of 8090 Software Factory.
Source of truth is the factory (project b415065f-ab2f-4f53-8864-0c009fd098cb);
this file is a checked-in mirror so CI can enforce traceability without
network or MCP access. Refresh it with `make ac-sync` (agent-driven, see
FLYWHEEL.md 1g) -- never hand-edit a criterion's text to make a check pass.
Every criterion listed here must be referenced by at least one test under
tests/ (in a docstring, a marker, or the test name). scripts/check_ac_coverage.py
enforces that with a ratchet: coverage may never regress.
_scope: Only AC families this repository actually implements are gated here.
The factory also holds AC-CLOUD-*, AC-BUILD-*, AC-DEVICE-* and AC-WEB-*
criteria; those are implemented in clawmetry-cloud, the hosted builder,
clawmetry-mac/firmware and the marketing site respectively. They are listed
under external_prefixes so a stray reference to one is not mistaken for a typo.

criteria.text: When an entitled extended runtime is available, the system shall observe its activity alongside the free runtimes.
If an operator is not entitled to an extended runtime, then the system shall communicate the entitlement boundary rather than presenting the runtime as observed.
When an extended runtime lacks a known value, the system shall preserve what it can identify without inventing the missing value.
When the user selects a supported compliance framework, the system shall present the controls it can assess.
When the user requests an evidence bundle, the system shall produce the evidence it holds for the selected framework.
The system shall identify the bundle as supporting evidence rather than as a certification.
If required evidence is unavailable, then the system shall identify the gap rather than presenting the control as satisfied.
When an evaluation is run for eligible agent activity, the system shall record its result against the evaluated activity.
When the system identifies an automation finding, the system shall present the finding with the evidence that produced it.
When an action can change an agent environment, the system shall require explicit operator initiation.
When an eligible assessment completes, the system shall record its result against the evaluated activity.
If adequate evidence is unavailable, then the system shall report the assessment as inconclusive rather than as passed.
When the system identifies a remediation finding, the system shall present the finding with its supporting evidence.
When an operator requests a supported remediation action, the system shall report its accepted, rejected, or failed outcome.
The system shall not apply a remediation action without explicit operator initiation.
When the auditor selects a supported framework, the system shall present the controls it can assess from retained evidence.
When a control lacks necessary evidence, the system shall identify the evidence gap.
The system shall not represent a control assessment as a formal certification.
When an auditor requests an evidence export, the system shall produce the retained records for the requested scope.
If a requested record is unavailable, then the system shall identify the omission in the export.
When an entitled supported runtime is detected, the system shall observe and normalize its activity into the common model.
If the runtime adapter cannot read a required data source, then the system shall report the unavailable source without presenting partial data as complete.
When the extension is absent or not entitled, the system shall communicate the availability boundary.

When an active require_approval policy applies to cursor or copilot, ClawMetry installs the runtime's native pre-tool hook and removes it when no policy wants it; foreign hook entries are never modified.
Each gated runtime posts to its own pre-tool receiver URL and its approval rows carry that runtime; policies are runtime-scope filtered before matching.
The gate is fail-open end to end: any client or server failure results in 'no opinion' and the runtime's own permission flow proceeds; a broken ClawMetry can never stall the calling agent.
A deny decision reaches the agent with the operator's reason, in the runtime's own response contract.
Runtime-scoped policy selection sits inside the same fail-open guard as policy loading and matching: a selection failure answers 'allow' with a stated reason.

A runtime hosting sessions in more than one execution model is classified per session, never wholly available: it is named explicitly as split-support, so the safe default for a session that cannot be placed is refusal.
When activity is available from a supported runtime, the system shall present the associated sessions and activity records to the operator.
When a session contains messages, tool activity, or trace activity, the system shall present those records in the session context.
If no supported runtime activity is available, then the system shall indicate that no activity is available and provide setup-oriented guidance.
When new activity becomes available, the system shall make it available without requiring the operator to recreate the observed runtime.
When the operator opens the local observability experience, the system shall present available session, usage, health, and scheduled-work status.
When a supported runtime has active work, the system shall identify the runtime and its active session state.
If a required local data source is unavailable, then the system shall identify the unavailable source without presenting unavailable data as current.
When the system recognizes a supported runtime, the system shall associate its activity with that runtime.
When runtime-specific information is unavailable, the system shall preserve the activity that it can identify without inventing missing values.
Where an extended runtime integration requires the paid extension, the system shall communicate the availability boundary before the operator relies on it.

For every supported runtime, the system shall report a session's current phase using one shared vocabulary -- waiting on a person, working, idle, or ended -- so that sessions from different runtimes can be compared and ordered together.
Where the observed data cannot determine a session's phase, the system shall report the phase as unknown, and shall not report it as idle or as ended.

The system shall report how long a session has been in its current phase, measured from the transition into it, and that duration shall continue to be measured from the transition after the observing service restarts.
The system shall treat a phase as active only where it has been declared active, so that a phase value the system does not recognise is reported as not active.

Where a session has ended, the system shall report why it ended, distinguishing a session that concluded from one that went stale, one whose process is gone, and one that was archived, and shall not report an abandoned session as a concluded one.

The system shall report the directory a session was launched in, recorded when the session is first observed and not rewritten afterwards, so that a later comparison against where the session is running is possible.
Where a session is waiting on a person, the system shall report whether that ask can be answered through ClawMetry, so that a surface never offers an action it cannot perform.
The system shall record each received telemetry record at the time the record itself reports, and shall use the time of receipt only when the record carries no time of its own.
The system shall retain the identity carried on a received record -- the person, their organisation, and the session -- together with any team or repository the sender declared.
Received telemetry shall be readable after a restart of the service that received it.

The system shall report spend and token totals grouped by team, by repository, or by person, from received records alone. Every such answer shall state that the grouping is self-reported by the sender.
Re-delivery of a batch already received shall not change any reported total, in stored records or in the live view.
Where the same session is observed both from the machine and from received telemetry, the system shall report it once, and shall prefer the machine's own observation.

Tool decisions and tool results arriving as telemetry shall be usable by the trajectory detectors, so that a stuck or repeatedly failing agent is visible on a machine with nothing installed on it. A permission the user REFUSED shall not be reported as a tool the agent ran.
Where this path is described to a customer, the description shall state which runtimes it covers and that records arrive unencrypted.
When cost or usage is available, the system shall present it with its associated runtime, session, or time scope.
When a cost value cannot be determined, the system shall identify it as unavailable rather than report a zero value.
When the operator changes the available time scope, the system shall update the displayed measurements to that scope.

Where a runtime records cost for only part of its work, the system shall present the figure it has AND identify it as a floor rather than a total. Suppressing it would understate real spend; presenting it plainly would overstate what is known.
When the system identifies an efficiency signal, the system shall present the signal with its associated activity context.
If the supporting activity is no longer available, then the system shall identify the efficiency signal as lacking current supporting context.

When prompt caching is in use, the system shall present the cache hit rate as an efficiency signal with the amount already saved and a conservative estimate of the amount left on the table, and shall label the estimate as an estimate rather than as a measured value.

When a model in observed use has a safe cheaper same-provider sibling that would fit the observed workload, the system shall present a routing recommendation with the current model, the suggested model, the observed call volume, and the estimated monthly savings, and shall reconcile the recommendation's scope with the active runtime filter.
When automatic model downgrades have already occurred, the system shall present the already-realised savings alongside the potential-savings recommendation without conflating the two.
When a finding is reported, the system shall present an estimate of the cost of the flagged period rather than the total cost of the session.
The system shall state how each estimate was arrived at, and shall distinguish a measured figure from an approximation.
When cost cannot be determined, the system shall report it as unavailable rather than present a figure.
The system shall order lists of findings by that estimate, and where estimates are equal shall fall back to how serious the finding is.
An approximation shall not raise the seriousness of a finding; only a measured figure shall.
When only part of a list is shown to an operator, the system shall show the most costly entries rather than the most recent.
The system shall record, for each session, how much work it did and where it reached, so that later sessions can be compared against it.
Re-examining a session that is still running shall update that session's record rather than add another.
When a population has never exhibited a behaviour the system relies on observing, the system shall stop reporting the absence of that behaviour as a finding for that population.
The system shall retain these records for a bounded period and discard older ones.
The system shall report the cost of an agent's work alongside whether that work reached a merged change, reached a branch only, or reached neither.
The system shall never modify a repository it reads: no checkout, no fetch, no configuration change, and no write of any kind.

When a pull-request host is unavailable or its tooling is not installed, the system shall report what local branch and merge state supports and shall state that pull-request state is unavailable, rather than failing or omitting the surface.
Every reported figure shall carry the basis it was derived from, and a figure resting on an uncertain correlation shall be reported as uncertain rather than presented next to certain ones.
Spend on abandoned work shall be counted only for sessions whose runtime reported that they ended. An inactive session shall not be treated as an abandoned one.
Sessions whose working directory is unknown shall be reported as not attributable, with a count, rather than silently dropped from the totals.
Outcomes shall be attributed to a runtime, a model or a repository, and shall not be attributed to a named person.
A named window of time on this surface shall mean the same span as the same-named window on every other cost surface.
Reading a repository shall be bounded in how much history it examines and in how long it may take, and shall be capable of being switched off entirely on a node.
When an operator creates or changes a valid policy, the system shall retain the policy for its authorized scope.
When an operator evaluates a policy against historical activity, the system shall show the resulting candidate matches without changing historical activity.
If a policy is invalid, then the system shall identify the invalid policy without enabling it.
When an approval request is pending, the system shall present its available action context and decision options to an authorized approver.
When an approver decides a pending request, the system shall record the decision outcome and make it visible to the relevant workflow.
If a request is expired, already decided, or unavailable, then the system shall not accept a new decision.
When the operator requests integrity verification, the system shall report whether the retained records pass or fail the available integrity check.
If integrity verification finds an unexpected record change, then the system shall identify that the verification failed.

When every retained record still matches its own recorded fingerprint but the records cannot be arranged into a single ordered chain, the system shall report a third outcome, distinct from both pass and fail, and shall state that no record was altered or removed.

The system shall report verification failure only when a record's stored content no longer matches its recorded fingerprint, or when a record names a predecessor that is absent from the log. Incomplete ordering alone shall not be reported as failure.
When cloud synchronization is not configured, the system shall continue to provide local observability without requiring cloud access.
When the operator enables cloud synchronization, the system shall communicate the information category and protection boundary associated with the synchronization.
When the operator disables cloud synchronization, the system shall stop new optional synchronization activity.
The system shall present the retention period currently in force for local activity history, and shall state which setting is producing it.
The operator shall be able to shorten the retention period, and the choice shall persist on the node across restarts.

The system shall never lengthen retention beyond the entitlement's ceiling. A request for a longer period shall be recorded as requested but shall not extend what is kept, and the system shall report both the requested and the enforced period.
The system shall reject a retention value that is not a whole number of days of at least one, rather than substituting a default.
The component that deletes aged history shall use the same resolved period the system reports to the operator.
The operator shall be able to clear their choice and return to the entitlement's period.

Before shortening the retention period, the system shall state what will be deleted and that the deletion is permanent, and shall require confirmation. Raising the period, or returning to the plan's period, destroys nothing and shall not require confirmation.
When the operator selects an available session, the system shall present its ordered activity records.
When an activity record has associated tool input, result, or error information, the system shall present the available associated information in that session context.
If the selected session has no recorded activity, then the system shall indicate that the session is empty.
When trace information is available for an operation, the system shall present its related activity records in their available relationship.
If trace information is incomplete, then the system shall identify the available records without implying complete coverage.

Family adapters emit each spawned child as a session with a parent link and a kind of sub-agent, workflow run, or workflow agent; the sync daemon records these on the subagents table via an explicit whitelist into the row's data blob.
Still-running children are re-read on every sync pass so their live status never goes stale; child transcript events are ingested under the child's own namespaced session id.

GET /api/session-orchestration/<session_id> returns the full orchestration tree for one session, accepting bare or runtime-prefixed ids, from the local store only, with an honest empty tree otherwise.
GET /api/orchestration-summary?session_ids=... returns bulk per-session counts without prompt or reply text, backed by query_subagents_lite and exposed through the daemon query proxy allowlist.
The Activity feed offers per-session filter chips that work on the local-store fast path, labels child runs as sub-agent or workflow-agent blocks, and shows an orchestration badge per session block.
The Sessions tab transcript viewer includes an Orchestration panel with expandable per-agent 'Context given' and 'Replied' blocks; it auto-expands while anything is still running.
A workflow-run row carries no tokens or cost of its own; its agents own their usage, so orchestration rollups never double-count.
OpenClaw sub-agent and flow registries in state/openclaw.sqlite are mirrored into the subagents table; the subagents data blob merges across writers so no pass erases another's fields.
Only genuine delegations carry a parent link. Forks, compression continuations and resume seeds keep their lineage in the session's extra data with no parent id.

When an agent mutates an unusual number of files for its history, or runs a destructive command such as a recursive delete at a home or system root, the system shall report it while the session is still running.
When an agent opens a credential bearing artefact, the system shall report the CATEGORY of what was opened and shall not record its path.
When an agent contacts an external destination it has no history of contacting, the system shall report it, and shall stay silent on that ground until it has enough history to make the claim.
When an agent escalates privilege or weakens a system protection, the system shall report it, and shall distinguish actions that outlive the session from ordinary elevation.
Every report derived from tool arguments shall state that origin, so that no reader mistakes it for kernel level observation.
When a pattern appears inside a document the agent wrote, or inside a command that only inspects text, the system shall not report it as an action.
No report shall contain a full command line or a full filesystem path.
When a runtime records file changes in a form the system can observe, the system shall treat those changes as progress for that runtime, including where the change is made through a shell command.
When a population of comparable sessions is too small to characterise, the system shall apply its shipped defaults rather than a measurement.
When a measurement is used, the system shall bound it so that neither an unusually busy population nor an unusually quiet one can disable or saturate reporting.
The system shall state, for each reported finding, whether the threshold it crossed was measured or shipped.
When an operator sets a threshold for a specific runtime, the system shall prefer that value over both the shipped default and any measurement.
The system shall attribute a session to the runtime that produced it, and shall not rely on a stored value that can disagree with the session's own identity.
The system shall not transmit a session title to the hosted service in a form that service can read.
The system shall carry session titles to the hosted dashboard by the same encrypted path as other session content, keyed so that a title can be matched to the session it belongs to.
Where a session has no title of its own, the system shall carry nothing rather than an identifier presented as a title.
A failure to produce titles shall degrade to no titles, and shall never prevent the rest of the snapshot from being produced.
Session records persist the working directory and git branch when the runtime records them (first-class fields on the session row); an unavailable directory stays empty, never fabricated.
The first-class cwd field is the contract consumers act on; an adapter's mirror of the same value in extra metadata is compatibility-and-diagnostic only for older wheels.
Family-runtime event rows carry the session's working directory as their workspace attribution so approval deny-kills can resolve cwd-based runtimes.

Report, for a repository named by the operator or discovered from session history, a grade for how legible that repository is to an agent, covering instruction file, test command, build command, lint or format gate, CI configuration and repository-scoped agent skills.
Report, beside that grade and for the same repository, how many sessions ran there in a stated window and how many of them the detectors recorded as stuck.
Report every passing check with the specific path that was read to reach that verdict, and every failing check with the paths that were looked for plus a remediation the operator can act on.
Report a check whose input could not be read as an explicit unknown that does not affect the grade in either direction, rather than as a failure or a pass.
Report a repository with no recorded session history as having no history, distinctly from a repository where sessions ran and none got stuck.
Report, per runtime, which runtimes would find their instructions in the repository, and scope the graded result to the runtime the operator has selected.
Complete without making any network request and without executing any command from the repository under examination.
Remain available on every plan, including free, with no entitlement gate.
